Zapata Quantum has secured an oversubscribed $15 million financing round after a recent restructuring, raising capital to support growth in the quantum computing sector. The company plans to use the funds to expand its portfolio of quantum applications and accelerate product development. This funding round reflects investor confidence in Zapata Quantum’s technology and its strategic growth initiatives.
